Class GLInterface

java.lang.Object
icyllis.arc3d.opengl.GLInterfaceCommon
icyllis.arc3d.opengl.GLInterface
public class GLInterface extends GLInterfaceCommon
Interface for gl* function access between OpenGL 4.6 Core and OpenGL ES 3.2, plus some extensions, depending on GLCapabilities or GLESCapabilities.

No javadoc here, please refer to LWJGL javadoc and OpenGL specification.
